environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-13900HX with hybrid cores
environment.configuration: 2D Release -O2, C++23, PCH ON, LTO OFF, compiler cache OFF, mold linker
environment.host_load: Other user builds can run concurrently; benchmark builds run sequentially.

implementation.scene_type_registration: Ten named type definitions use individual member statements instead of forwarding large heterogeneous member tuples through sol2.
implementation.callback_adapters: Captured callbacks are represented by std::function of their signature; noncapturing entity callbacks use function pointers. This shares sol2 invocation adapters across compatible callback signatures.
implementation.safety_and_optimization: Compiler optimization, sol2 safety settings, API names, callback bodies and captures retained. All changes are private engine implementation details.
implementation.mechanical_check: Removing wrapper syntax and reconstructing the original registration calls exactly reproduces both old .cpp files, including callback bodies and member order.

script_engine.note: Trace totals are nested/overlapping; only Frontend and Backend approximately partition execution. Template and optimizer totals must not be added to them.

entity_scripts.note: Trace totals are nested/overlapping; only Frontend and Backend approximately partition execution. Template and optimizer totals must not be added to them.

clang_compile_method: One uninstrumented direct compile before/after per file, CPU affinity 2, canonical flags/PCH from each build compile database. Order: scene before/after, entity after/before. Other CPUs remain available to other builds.

gcc_full_runtime_rebuild.method: One fresh before/after pair at four jobs with affinity 0,2,4,6 (four distinct performance cores). Rebuild all Kin and hex_demo objects/PCHs, archive and link. Third-party libraries, shader/embedding outputs and CMake configuration prebuilt. Compiler settings match after normalizing worktree/build paths.
gcc_full_runtime_rebuild.scope: Full Kin/runtime rebuild through hex_demo; excludes dependency compilation and initial configuration. Compile wall times in the task traces include competition between four compiler jobs.
gcc_full_runtime_rebuild.interpretation: Not an isolated clean-build speedup estimate: unchanged engine tasks slowed by about 20% in the after run while other projects built concurrently.

runtime_checks.method: Three processes per compiler/configuration, CPU affinity 2. Each process takes 30 measured samples after 3 warmups and reports its median. Before/after order alternates by process round. Summary is median of the three process medians.

cases.scene_vm_create_ms: Construct and destroy a scene VM with bindings.
cases.scene_20000_calls_ms: 10,000 iterations calling alive and translate; also reads ctx.dt.
cases.entity_50000_calls_ms: 100 entities, 100 iterations each: alive, position, move, rotation, set_rotation; includes normal entity-script update overhead.

runtime_checks.result_checks: Scene/entity x positions equal 330000 and 3300 in every process; failures abort the probe.

validation.added_regression_checks: Constructible dialogue type, working properties/method, rejected read-only assignment, and forbidden entity constructor.

rejected_experiments.experiment: Explicit custom-command dependencies and static-library dependency pruning
rejected_experiments.result: Scheduling simulations predicted no substantial gain. No CMake/flag changes retained.
Increased compilation CPU time; replaced by direct member statements.

limits: CPU affinity does not reserve a core or isolate its SMT sibling. Other project compilers were observed on SMT siblings during the full pair.
Single fresh build pair and single pinned direct pair per source. Host load, thermal/frequency and filesystem effects can influence timings; these are local observations.
Early exploratory unpinned and profiler-instrumented samples are diagnostic; they are not used as the final paired compile comparison.
Runtime spot checks cover the named workloads, not complete game performance. One Clang entity sample was an outlier; all process samples are retained.
Per-process RSS metrics are not total simultaneous build RAM.
No MSVC or full 3D runtime test suite was run for this phase.
Installed GCC and Clang have different implicit hardening defaults; these are within-compiler comparisons, not an isolated cross-compiler ranking.
